Let’s talk about your workflow
04 /QUESTIONS

Questions shops
ask us.

Does it understand our working hours?

Plan around each machine’s shifts, maintenance, Japanese public holidays, and shop closure days. The schedule follows the time your shop actually works.

Can we plan the way we already work?

Schedule by hand, use a proposal for the remaining work, or combine both. Support batch and one-piece flow, inspection steps, and outsourced operations.

Is it available in Japanese?

Yes. Scheduler supports Japanese and English, with shop-floor terms such as 段取り and 検査. Switch the interface language while keeping your part and order names.

Does it connect to machines or our ERP?

Not yet, and you don’t need it to start. Scheduler works on its own, with the planner keeping the board up to date. ERP integration and multi-user editing are planned for later.

What happens in a demo?

We’ll discuss your machines, shifts, and a few of your part processes, then explore planning a real week together. Your preferred time is confirmed by email.
